title: 第83章 别拿我闺女开玩笑

第83章 别拿我闺女开玩笑-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

第二天一早，林国强去供销社卤味柜台看了看。

柜台重新开了，玻璃柜擦得锃亮，卤味码得整整齐齐。

排队的人比出事前还多。

镇上的人都说，林老板的卤味没问题，是有人眼红害他。

赵志军送完货，凑过来低声说：“三姐夫，今天卖得比往常还好。”

林国强拍了拍他肩膀。

“好好干。”

供销社门口，刘胜利穿着一身新中山装，左胸口袋别着钢笔，跟商户们打招呼。

看见林国强，他赶紧走过来，低声说：“国强，晚上有空没？去哥家喝两盅？”

林国强看了看他，点了点头：“行。”

国强饭店生意稳当了，天天客满。

人多了，麻烦也多了。

镇上有几个叫花子，闻着味儿就来了。

领头的姓何，四十来岁，瘸了一条腿，大家都叫他何瘸子。

刚开始只是饭点过后，蹲在后门等着。

王大柱把剩菜剩饭端出去，他接了就走了，倒也安分。

可没过几天，变本加厉了。

何瘸子带了三四个人来，不光在后门等着，还跑到店门口蹲着。

客人进门，他们就伸手。

有的客人不好意思，给个几分钱。

有的客人嫌烦，扭头就走。

赵志军出去撵过两回，他们散了一会儿又回来了。

王大柱气得不行：“林老板，我去把他们轰走！”

林国强擦了擦手，走出后门。

何瘸子正蹲在墙根底下啃半个馒头，看见林国强，咧嘴一笑：“林老板，生意兴隆啊。”

林国强没笑。

“何瘸子，咱们定个规矩。”

何瘸子收起笑脸。

“第一，以后不许蹲在店门口，客人进出，你们离远点。”

“第二，剩菜剩饭可以给你们，但不是白给。

后门的泔水桶，你们每天负责倒了，刷干净。

后门的垃圾，归你们扫。

干完了，剩饭剩菜端走，不干，没有。”

何瘸子脸色不好看了：“林老板，你这是......”

“第三。”林国强没给他说完的机会，“我这饭店是做生意的，不是施粥棚。

你们要是觉得我这规矩多，现在就可以走。

镇上饭店不止我一家。”

何瘸子看了看身后的几个人，又看了看林国强。

林国强站在后门口，脸上没什么表情。

不是凶神恶煞，也不是好商好量。

Early the next morning, Lin Guoqiang went to the supply and marketing cooperative's braised food counter to take a look.

The counter was reopened, the glass cabinets were polished, and the braised food was neatly listed.

There were more people lining up than before the accident.

People in the town said that Boss Lin’s braised food was fine, but someone was jealous and harmed him.

After Zhao Zhijun finished delivering the goods, he came over and whispered: "Third brother-in-law, today's sales are better than usual."

Lin Guoqiang patted him on the shoulder.

"Good job."

At the entrance of the supply and marketing cooperative, Liu Shengli, wearing a new Chinese tunic suit and a pen in his left breast pocket, greeted the merchants.

Seeing Lin Guoqiang, he hurried over and whispered: "Guoqiang, are you free tonight? Come to my brother's house for a drink?"

Lin Guoqiang looked at him and nodded: "Okay."

The business of Guoqiang Hotel is stable and it is full every day.

With more people comes more trouble.

There were a few beggars in the town, and they came here after smelling the smell.

The leader's surname was He. He was in his forties and was lame in one leg. Everyone called him He Laizi.

At first, I just squatted at the back door and waited after dinner.

Wang Dazhu brought the leftovers out, and he took them and left, which was quite calm.

But within a few days, it got worse.

He Laizi brought three or four people with him. Not only did they wait at the back door, they also ran to the front of the store and squatted there.

When guests come in, they extend their hands.

Some customers are embarrassed and give a few cents.

Some guests found it annoying and turned away.

Zhao Zhijun went out to chase them away twice. They dispersed for a while and then came back.

Wang Dazhu was so angry: "Boss Lin, I'll blow them away!"

Lin Guoqiang wiped his hands and walked out of the back door.

He Laizi was squatting under the wall and eating half a bun. When he saw Lin Guoqiang, he grinned: "Boss Lin, business is booming."

Lin Guoqiang did not laugh.

"He Laizi, let's make a rule."

He Zizi put away his smile.

"First of all, you are not allowed to squat in front of the store in the future. When customers come in and out, you should stay away."

“Second, I can give you the leftovers, but it’s not for free.

You are responsible for emptying and cleaning the swill bucket at the back door every day.

The garbage at the back door is yours to clean.

After the work is done, the leftovers are taken away. If you don’t do it, there will be none."

He Zizi's face turned ugly: "Boss Lin, what are you..."

"Third." Lin Guoqiang didn't give him a chance to finish, "My restaurant is a business, not a soup kitchen.

If you think I have too many rules, you can leave now.

I’m not the only restaurant in town."

He Zizi looked at the people behind him and then at Lin Guoqiang.

Lin Guoqiang stood at the back door with no expression on his face.

He is not evil, nor is he easy to negotiate with.
